messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Temporal and Spatio-temporal models
parts:
There is no objective answer to this. Depends on the details of the problem, what you want to do, and the data structure. Model comparison can be used between several models.

On Tue, 21 Jan 2020 at 02:33, Dan <udaniwij...@gmail.com> wrote:
Instead of complex methods, if I use
Temporal -
Y ~ b + aX + f(year, model=ar1) + f(space, model=iid) + €

Spatio-temporal -
Y ~ b + aX + f(year, model=ar1) + f(space, model=spde) + €

are these give the correct outputs?

Or

Do I have to use both space time effect together?

Waiting for your kind immediate response.

Thank you.
Dan
